name: Tsun Ane Princess Emiria to Nangoku Oukyuu Kozukuri ~Nakadashi nante Namaiki yo! Aka-chan Dekiru made Yurusanain Dakara!~
original_name: ツンあねプリンセス・エミリアと南国王宮子作り～中出しなんて生意気よ！赤ちゃん出来るまで許さないんだからね！～
source:
The main character is an ordinary student.
One day, he is kidnapped by someone and when he wakes up, he finds himself surrounded by 3 beautiful women in a luxury palace.
They turn out to be princesses in a small tropical country and ask for the childmaking to be regarded as the official couple.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE054395.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名普通学生。
有一天，他被人绑架，醒来后发现自己在一座豪华宫殿里，被三位美女包围。
他们原来是一个热带小国的公主，并要求抚养孩子被视为正式夫妇。

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE054395.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
